text:
Health insurance open enrollment starts Sunday, Nov 1. The ads are already everywhere.

Yesterday the FTC warned 25 health plan marketers about fake government ties, fake "free" cash offers and plans sold as full insurance that aren't.

Before you give anyone your info, paste the ad or text into Claude and ask for every red flag and what it may not cover.

Real plans live on HealthCare.gov or your state's site.

What's the sketchiest health plan call or text you've gotten?
